train_args.data: /tmp/visdrone_yolo_9rolehtr/dataset.yaml (ephemeral path; standard Ultralytics VisDrone2019-DET conversion, not VisDrone-MOT)
train_args.val_split_used_for_checkpoint_selection: val (VisDrone2019-DET val, 548 images); this is a best.pt (fitness-selected on DET val), not a last-epoch checkpoint

checkpoint_metadata_verified_by_torch_lo.note_on_epoch_field: -1 is the normal value after ultralytics strip_optimizer() on a finalized export; does not indicate 0 training epochs (train_args.epochs=300 confirmed, and fitted weights behave accordingly in sanity inference).

dataset_provenance.dataset: VisDrone2019-DET (still-image object detection benchmark: 6471 train / 548 val / 1610 test-dev)
dataset_provenance.NOT: VisDrone2019-MOT (56 video sequences / ~24,201 train frames) -- this is the set our own in-house training and AC-MOT protocol use
dataset_provenance.det_vs_mot_overlap_check: VisDrone-DET and VisDrone-MOT are documented as distinct, non-overlapping video/image collections in the VisDrone benchmark design (separate challenge tracks, separate capture sets); no direct frame-level overlap verification was performed beyond this, since the two tracks are independently curated by the VisDrone organizers.
dataset_provenance.relation_to_our_held_out_visdrone_mot_va: No evidence of leakage into our final held-out VisDrone2019-MOT-val; this checkpoint was never exposed to, or selected against, our evaluation data.

sanity_check.performed_on: Mac CPU, ultralytics==8.3.200 (pinned), single calibration-sequence frame (uav0000013_00000_v, frame 50) -- NOT final held-out VisDrone-MOT-val, NOT used for threshold tuning or model selection
sanity_check.result: 91 detections, plausible class distribution (pedestrian/people/motor/bicycle/awning-tricycle), confidence range 0.254-0.839; no catastrophic failure, no NaN/garbage output
sanity_check.cuda_sanity_check: pending -- to be run briefly on the Lightning T4 (load + inference at 1088/1280/1536, class-output check) before cache generation, per the no-tuning quick-audit requirement

class_mapping_for_acmot_eval5_protocol.dropped_classes: checkpoint indices 1 (people), 2 (bicycle), 6 (tricycle), 7 (awning-tricycle), 9 (motor), 10 (others) are dropped post-detection for the eval5 protocol -- identical in kind to how the in-house training's own eval5 mapping already drops non-eval5 raw VisDrone classes; no evaluation semantics changed.

runner_up_candidate.why_not_selected: Nearly empty model card (no reported metrics, invalid config.json); weaker documented provenance than dronefreak despite a cleaner 10-class output (no 'others' class) and a closer-matching Ultralytics version (8.3.29) and a more permissive license (OpenRAIL). Kept in external_weights_audit/ for reference; not deleted.

what_this_checkpoint_is_not: NOT the exact official OATrack YOLO11m-smallobj detector (that checkpoint is not publicly released; the OATrack paper's data-availability statement states materials are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request only)

NOT a reproduction of OATrack's detector training protocol (different dataset: DET not MOT; different imgsz: 640 not 1536; epochs/augmentation/class-set choices undocumented by OATrack and not matched here)
status: FROZEN -- do not fine-tune; use identically across all four main systems (YOLO11m+ByteTrack, YOLO11m+frozen OATrack, AC-MOT+YOLO11m+ByteTrack, AC-MOT+YOLO11m+frozen OATrack)
